facts.claim: 后记先向读完全书的人道贺，说他们已接近‘字词句子不再有意义’的状态，并随手甩出三个无意义词作证。
facts.quote: You must be approaching the point where words and sentences barely make sense anymore anchor, floorboard, wildebeest.

facts.claim: 对先翻到后记的读者，作者用‘跳到结论’的字面义警告别先看结尾。
facts.quote: If you’ve come to this page first, do be careful: no good can come from jumping to conclusions.

facts.claim: 用‘推倒一棵生菜’接‘冰山一角’，把两个不相干的比喻硬拼成混合比喻。
facts.quote: But just like pushing over a lettuce, this is the tip of the iceberg.

facts.claim: 接着把‘只抓到皮毛’换成‘只挠到冲浪者’，继续故意错配比喻。
facts.quote: Like a naked cat attacking beachgoers, you’ve barely scratched the surfers.

facts.claim: 说修女笑话有数千则而本书一则未收，用 nun/none 同音收尾。
facts.quote: There are thousands of jokes about nuns, for instance, and this book doesn’t contain any – nun whatsoever.

facts.claim: 用‘电工电了德国女人的儿子’来讲‘力量在你手上’，靠 Hans/hands 同音。
facts.quote: as the electrician said when he electrocuted a German woman’s son, the power is in your Hans.

facts.claim: 作者给出烂笑话的正面价值：翻白眼与勉强的笑能跨越分歧、让人变得成熟，并以 immature/fully groan 双关收束。
facts.quote: Before a bad joke we’re immature, but afterwards? Fully groan.

facts.claim: 结尾催读者去讲笑话，并把 go forth（出发）改成排队语境下的 go first（先来）。
facts.quote: So, go forth (or, if there aren’t three people trying to go before you, just go first) and joke!

relations.relation: 都以语言失效或同音（nun/none）作笑点，收束全书对‘烂笑话’的自我指涉。
relations.quote: There are thousands of jokes about nuns, for instance, and this book doesn’t contain any – nun whatsoever.

relations.pair: 推倒生菜+冰山一角 / 裸猫+只挠到冲浪者
relations.relation: 后记连续用两个故意错配的混合比喻（malaphor），把‘本书只是一小部分’这句陈词说歪。
relations.quote: Like a naked cat attacking beachgoers, you’ve barely scratched the surfers.

relations.pair: jumping to conclusions / go first 排队
relations.relation: 把‘跳’与‘先’的字面义延伸到插队玩笑，与开头的字面义玩笑首尾呼应。
relations.quote: So, go forth (or, if there aren’t three people trying to go before you, just go first) and joke!

numbers.meaning: 全书笑话总量被说成数百则，且同时冠以 terrible 与 excellent。
numbers.quote: well done for making it through hundreds of consistently terrible excellent jokes

numbers.meaning: 修女笑话有数千则，本书一则未收。
numbers.quote: There are thousands of jokes about nuns, for instance, and this book doesn’t contain any – nun whatsoever.

numbers.meaning: 结尾设想排队时前面有三个人，才配用 go forth。
numbers.quote: if there aren’t three people trying to go before you, just go first
